bibliographic.title: The Copper Tavern
bibliographic.author: Alexander
bibliographic.description:
An Interactive Adventure based on handwritten notes.

You wake up in a dense forest with nothing but ragged clothes and an absurdly out-of-place, fully automatic AK-47.

Just off the path lies the Copper Tavern, a cozy drinking hole facing imminent destruction under the king's harsh eviction order. To help the tavernkeeper and secure ownership of the inn, you’ll need to explore the surrounding woods, outsmart local scoundrels, sneak into private quarters, and gamble your way to a small fortune.

Whether you rely on stealth, lockpicks, or high-caliber modern firepower, will you find a way to clear the debt before time runs out?
